dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "your_main_script.py"]
explanation: The requirements.txt includes all detected imports with pinned versions for stability. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as the base image, installs the dependencies from requirements.txt, copies the application code, and sets a default command to run the main script. Adjust 'your_main_script.py' to your actual entry point.
